description:
🌌 Dynamic Asteroids
Breathes kinetic life into static asteroid belts & deep space combat!

Game Version: Starsector 0.98.5a (Supports 0.98a-RC8) | Compatibility: Java 8 (Vanilla & Custom JREs)
Required Dependency: LunaLib | Mod Author & Contact (Discord): keltuze

☄️ What is Dynamic Asteroids?
In vanilla Starsector, asteroids just hang completely motionless in space as passive background scenery.

Dynamic Asteroids completely overhauls combat terrain, turning dull asteroid fields, planetary rings, and deep space into roaring, dynamic kinetic battlefields! Asteroids rush through combat in directional streams and high-velocity avalanche waves, forcing both you and enemy fleets to navigate tactical debris hazards, brace shields against kinetic impacts, and utilize drifting terrain for mobile cover.

Beyond hazardous debris, the mod introduces high-stakes salvage operations: reel in drifting Domain survey probes and ancient cargo caches with your shield tractor beam, rescue abandoned derelict hulls and recruit them directly into your fleet, detonate volatile antimatter fuel canisters near enemy formations, and dodge colossal straight-vector Megaliths cruising through the crossfire.

📦 DOWNLOADS (v2.1.0 Latest Release)

📥 Download Standard Edition (EN) [v2.1.0]
📥 Скачать русскую версию (RU) [v2.1.0]

🔗 GitHub Repository & Releases | 💾 100% safe to add or remove mid-campaign (writes zero data to save files).

✨ Core Features of the Mod
• Living Asteroid Streams & Avalanches: Asteroid belts on the campaign map trigger rushing rivers of kinetic debris in combat with realistic drift, velocity, and ramming collision physics. Open space remains calm with rare sparse meteors.
• Colossal Bedrock Megaliths: Giant planetoid-sized boulders fly straight through the sector. Small rocks bounce off them harmlessly; touching or shooting a megalith untethers it into a free Newtonian physical body that you can push and use as mobile cover.
• Guaranteed Derelict Ship Rescue: Rare abandoned hulls drift through debris streams. Hold and stabilize them with your shield magnet for 60 seconds (or hold for at least 2s when winning the battle), and they are guaranteed to join your fleet after combat with weapons intact and standard D-mods!
• Interactive Salvage & Volatile Hazards: Domain survey probes, equipment caches, cryopods, and fighter LPCs drift through space — reel them in with your shield for instant collection. Highly volatile antimatter fuel canisters detonate with massive 1,200 HE blast waves when shot or rammed!
• Reinforced Point Defense (8.0x Damage): Point defense weapons deal standardized 8.0x damage against incoming rocks, reliably vaporizing debris before it breaches shields or hull.
• Station & Fleet Deflection Domes: Orbital stations project holographic deflector domes to part oncoming rock streams (collapsing temporarily if sections overload), while newly deployed fleet ships enter battle under a 7-second protective deflector barrier.
• 5 Live Presets in LunaLib (F2): Switch on the fly from gentle Cinematic drift to 3,000 u/s Extreme Chaos without restarting the game.

🚀 What's New in v2.1.0 (Compared to v2.0.75)

• 🧹 Zero-Allocation Architecture & 3,600+ Lines Cleaned Up:
- Before: The combat tick loop generated transient lists and object iterators each frame, causing minor garbage collection hiccups during prolonged, mass-fleet battles.
- Now: Over 3,600 lines of dead and duplicate logic purged. Complete zero-allocation advance loop with pre-allocated vectors and cached threats, eliminating Java GC stutter and ensuring rock-solid FPS even in heavy fleet engagements.

• 🪨 Cinematic Megalith Speed Rebalance (-50% Speed):
- Before: Giant boulders traveled at 90–140 u/s, hurtling through the battle too fast to react to, turning collisions into a lottery.
- Now: Colossal megalith speeds reduced by 50% (45 u/s base in Balanced). Megaliths now feel genuinely colossal, heavy, and cinematic, giving player ships and fleet AI plenty of reaction time to evade or raise shields. High-speed avalanche streams retain their full adrenaline speeds (400–3,000 u/s).

• 🚫 Disciplined Point Defense (PD Fires at Real Threats, Not Megaliths):
- Before: Point defense weapons treated giant Megaliths as high-priority collision threats and emptied their ammo and flux shooting at an indestructible giant rock.
- Now: PD mounts strictly ignore colossal Megaliths and focus purely on incoming missiles, strike craft, and destructible small/medium rocks. (Player-aimed fire and heavy ship batteries can still shatter Megaliths for salvage!).

• 🧲 Smooth Shield Magnet Ingestion [T] & Mouse 5 Retired:
- Before: Useful containers (probes, cryopods, caches, fighter LPCs) hovered at the shield perimeter and wouldn't get collected unless you dropped shields or rammed them with your hull. Side mouse button (Mouse 5) could accidentally trigger mid-turn.
- Now: Loot containers are pulled smoothly through your shield barrier directly into your ship's hull for instant collection! Derelict hulls still moor safely outside (+45u). Mouse 5 has been retired from default binding to prevent accidental clicks; toggling is now dedicated cleanly to [T] (fully rebindable).

• 🎁 Asteroid Mining Loot Balancing (60s Cooldown):
- Before: Spraying bullets into dense rock streams could trigger 5+ item drops in 30 seconds, cluttering the sector. Natural asteroid despawning also counted as kills.
- Now: Added a strict 60-second cooldown on drops from small asteroids, removed despawn triggers, and throttled projectile scanning to 5 Hz (-92% engine overhead). Megalith destruction retains its rare independent rewards.

• 🛡� AI Omni-Shield Hold Protection:
- Fixed the AI shield hold timer during close passes with colossal Megaliths, ensuring allied and enemy ships maintain forward shield coverage throughout the entire transit.

⌨️ Controls & Hotkeys
• [T] — Toggle Shield Magnet ON / OFF (Active in both campaign battles and simulator. Mouse 5 disabled by default, configurable in settings).
(Simulator-only hotkeys for testing):
• [/] — Toggle asteroid stream ON / OFF
• ['] — Spawn a test derelict ship
• [;] — Spawn a test Domain cache / explosive fuel tank
• [L] — Spawn a colossal megalith boulder
• [Shift + / -] — Adjust asteroid stream capacity
• [Ctrl + / -] — Adjust asteroid stream velocity

📜 Version History & Changelogs

v2.1.0 — Megalith Rebalance, Zero-Allocation Architecture & Smart Shield Magnet
• Zero-Allocation & 3,600+ Lines Purged: Overhauled combat advance loop with zero transient allocations and eliminated dead code for rock-solid FPS.
• 50% Megalith Speed Cut: Reduced megalith velocities by 50% (45 u/s base in Balanced) for cinematic pacing, keeping debris streams at full speed.
• Disciplined Point Defense: PD weapons strictly ignore colossal Megaliths, saving flux/ammo for missiles, fighters, and small asteroids.
• Smooth Shield Magnet Ingestion: Salvage containers and fighter LPCs are pulled through the shield for instant hull collection; derelict hulls stay safely moored outside.
• Mouse 5 Retired: Removed default side mouse button binding to eliminate accidental clicks; toggling is now strictly [T].
• Asteroid Drop Rate Cooldown: Added 60s cooldown on drops from small asteroids and throttled projectile hit scanning to 5 Hz (-92% scan overhead).
• Omni-Shield Hold Fix: AI ships properly maintain forward shield focus throughout the entire transit of a colossal Megalith.
• LunaLib Sync: Fully updated preset descriptions and default metrics in LunaLib menus.

v2.0.75 — Hotkeys & Reinforced PD Defense
• 8.0x PD Multiplier: Standardized 8.0x point defense damage against asteroids across all fixed presets.
• Straight Megaliths: Removed arc curving; megaliths fly straight (65% aimed at active ships).
• Vector Lock & Untethering: Small rocks cannot alter megalith course; ship contact or weapon fire untethers them into free physical bodies.
• 8–16 Megaliths Capacity: Asteroid belt battles maintain 8 to 16 simultaneous colossal megaliths.
• Shield Magnet Toggle [T]: In-combat hotkey toggle with floating "Magnit On" / "Magnit Off" indicators.
• Formations Buff: More frequent formations and multi-pattern stream combinations.

v2.0.70 — Direct Fleet Recovery & 14s Deflector Dome
• Direct Fleet Transfer: Stabilized derelict ships are directly transferred to player fleet after combat.
• 14-Second Deflector Dome: Extended deployment grace period with 98% kinetic collision reduction.
• Manual Controls Safety: Avoidance logic never overrides player controls during manual piloting.

v2.0.62 — Colossal Megaliths & Station Domes
• Added colossal megaliths with loot caches trapped inside their cores.
• Added station deflector domes that collapse on module flux overload.
• Fixed campaign detection in empty planetary ring gaps.

v2.0.6 — FixMagneto & Interactive Salvage
• Overhauled shield tractor beam with mass scaling and velocity damping.
• Added SOS derelict ships with 60s stabilization timers.
• Added volatile fuel tanks (1,200 HE blast waves).

v2.0.0 — Cyclone Edition (360° Formations)
• Added continuous background ring avalanche and multi-angle tactical formations.
• Added targeted snipe formations (5% chance).
• Optimized physics simulation to handle 200–300 rocks at smooth 120 FPS.

v1.0.0 — Initial Release
• Initial release: turned static vanilla asteroids into dynamic kinetic hazard streams.

Click above to check out the 1000x rock density stress test!

Click above to watch Dynamic Asteroids in action!

☕ Buy Me a Coffee / Оставить на чай
If you are enjoying Dynamic Asteroids and want to leave a small $1 tip (or any amount) to support my work, you can do it here. Every bit of support means the world to me!
Если вам нравится мод и вы хотите закинуть автору «на чай» (~100 рублей или любую другую сумму), буду очень благодарен за поддержку!

👉 Leave a Tip on Boosty / Поддержать на Boosty

🤖 AI Transparency & Development Disclaimer
In full transparency: All Java code in this mod was machine-generated through iterative architectural prompting and dialogue with an AI assistant (Google Antigravity / Gemini). The human author acted as creative director, game designer, and QA tester: designing mechanics, diagnosing engine collision quirks, directing physics models, fine-tuning gameplay balance, and overseeing save compatibility.

releases.changelogNotes:
only googledrive 2.0.65 vers
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gEQWJM_GFgX6X_ozRUzgdiGJPdnN-53T?usp=sharing
I haven't figured out the official version for the new game yet, so I've uploaded the fix separately to Google Drive. As soon as I finish fixing the bugs, I'll upload a new patch to GitHub for both the new and old versions of the game.

• Colossal Megaliths: Introduced giant planetoid-scale boulders (diameters up to 1100u) with pushable Newtonian physics and curved gravitational slingshot orbits.
• Megalith Shatter Loot: Shattering giant megaliths drops high-tier Domain caches (20%), preserved fighter LPC chips (1.5%), or entombed derelict hulls (0.1%).
• Station Deflection Domes: Orbital stations project deflector fields that part asteroid streams. Module flux overload or destruction collapses the shield, leaving the station exposed.
• Deployment Grace Period: Added 7 seconds of collision damage immunity upon entering battle with deflector visual cues.
• Formation Wave Density Buff: "Expanding Fan" and "Dual Rails" formations reinforced with +20 to +40 asteroids per stream with tighter firing cadence.
• Campaign Map Detection Fix: Battles in empty ring gaps or non-hazardous fine dust rings no longer trigger asteroid hazards — only physical asteroid fields do.
• Fixed Left Border Flickering Line: Resolved engine reflection conflict with obfuscated classes, permanently clearing vanilla 1-pixel border asteroid generators.
• Repellor Boundary Sync: Asteroids and debris drifting past combat border repellors now cleanly despawn after 5 seconds.
